headline: Both chambers take a breather with pro forma sessions before returning to full action Monday!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened briefly in pro forma session on August 13, meeting for just over thirty seconds at 8:01 a.m. before adjourning until the following week.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House held a pro forma session on August 13, convening at 9 a.m. and adjourning at 9:03 a.m. The chamber introduced 27 new public bills and 3 resolutions during this brief meeting.
